property_summary: For any address that previously locked a guess and then calls settle(), the reference contract always clears that caller's stored guess.block to zero (so a second immediate call to settle() by the same caller will revert), whereas the mutant that omits clearing can allow a second settle() call to proceed (or pay twice) for some inputs — specifically when the first settle sends value and the receiver re-enters once, the mutant will behave differently.
change_summary: Remove the clearing of the stored guess block (delete the state reset) so reentrancy or subsequent calls observe different state and some calls may now revert elsewhere.
